propositions: compact.py exceeds 800 LOC limit (798 LOC) and bundles three unrelated responsibilities: compaction transaction, snapshot reconstruction, and CLI surface in a single god command

circular import hazard arises if shared snapshot primitives are split between compact_txn and compact_rebuild; all four must live in compact_txn to maintain acyclic dependency graph (compact → {txn, rebuild}, rebuild → txn)
test monkeypatches on compact module object for _git and lock fail to apply after extraction because _compact_locked reads compact_txn's module globals; patches must be repointed to new home
get_rebuild_count must read the same module global as rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log or will silently report zero; counter and incrementer must co-locate in compact_rebuild with no separation

public re-export paths through rebar._commands.compact must be preserved for rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log, _snapshot_strip_keys, _build_authorship_ledger, and get_rebuild_count to maintain consumer compatibility without edits
